newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Tight supplies keep basis firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Tight supplies keep basis firm.

text.p: Cash soymeal basis offers were steady to mostly higher on Wednesday as eastern Corn Belt processors continued to seek soybeans in what was described as a very tight market, soymeal brokers said.

Wet weather throughout the Midwest which has slowed the fall harvest and reluctance on the part of farmers to sell new-crop soybeans has reduced supply in a time when export demand for soymeal is booming, cash sources said.
"These are attractive prices for everybody," one Tennessee broker said. "People have been waiting for it, and now the export market is hotter than ever."
Most don't see the supply situation being alleviated in the near future because recent wet weather has soaked many fields and virually halted harvest in some areas, cash sources said.
"The demand for soybean meal is going to remain strong as long as we continue to see wet corn," one Minnesota broker said.
